description:
General Information
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
New in the Original Packaging
What is this Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Level 3 Brake Rebuild Kit.
I designed this rebuild kit for people who want to replace everything on their brakes in both the front and rear
Gives you everything you need to completely rebuild the front and rear brakes on your Sammy at the lowest possible price
Suzuki OEM Part
Direct Replacement
Note: We sell additional OEM Brake Hoses if you require them.
What Will I Receive?
Front Brakes:
Qty 2 – Front Calipers
Qty 2 – Brake Pads (LH & RH Sides)
Qty 2 – Bleeder Plugs w/ Caps for Calipers
Rear Brakes:
Qty 4 – Brake Shoes
Qty 1 – Rear Brake Drum Repair Kit:
Qty 4 – Shoe Hold-down Pins
Qty 2 – Hold-down Springs
Qty 1 – Spring Rod – Left
Qty 1 – Spring Rod – Right
Qty 2 – Shoe Return Springs – Short
Qty 2 – Shoe Return Springs – Long
Qty 2 – Bleeder Valves
Qty 2 – Lever Seals
Qty 2 – Lever Seal Clips
Qty 2 – Lever Stopper
Qty 4 – Bolts & Lock Washer’s
Qty 2 – Cup & Boot Repair Kit
Plus:
Qty 1 – Rear Brake Cylinder (Driver Side)
Qty 1 – Rear Brake Cylinder (Passenger Side)
Qty 2 – Bleeder Plugs w/ Caps
Qty 1 – Rear Brake Lever Assembly (Driver Side)
Qty 1 – Rear Brake Lever Assembly (Passenger Side)
Qty 1 – Front Hydraulic Hose
Qty 1 – Rear Hydraulic Hose
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1988
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1988
